description: Evaluations for Cognitive Warfare and Cognitive EDR pitch deck generation with anti-slop verification.

evals.prompt: Створи інвестиційний план та 18 слайдів презентації для оборонного стартапу, що розробляє систему протидії когнітивним атакам для штабів НАТО на базі онтології другого порядку та шкали Admiralty.
expected_checks: Enforces ISO 21448 SOTIF framework for unknown-unsafe risk reduction
Includes Lakkaraju explore-exploit bandit triage to solve analyst fatigue
Provides MTOC / CCI mathematical metrology without claiming magic truth detection
Outputs 18-slide structure with Navy Blue #1B3A6B and takeaway banners

evals.prompt: We are building an enterprise threat intelligence tool that protects energy grids from coordinated panic deepfakes. Create a 1-page investor memo and pitch plan for a $2M seed round.
expected_checks: Positions as Cognitive EDR for critical infrastructure
Estimates TAM/SAM/SOM with realistic GovTech/Dual-Use ACV
Applies 8 anti-slop defense invariants to eliminate AI buzzwords

evals.prompt: Audit this pitch claim: 'Our AI uses generative transformers to autonomously detect 100% of Russian fake news before it spreads and changes public opinions with automated bots.'
expected_checks: Flags miracle claim of 100% autonomous truth detection as Red Slop
Identifies backfire effect risk of counter-bot messaging (SEIZ+ boundary)
Reframes claim using SOTIF open-space risk bounding and defensive proving ground
